title: Platinum Rewards Card: Getting Started with Your Platinum Account
summary: This document explains how to activate and set up the Platinum Rewards Card account, including enabling transaction/payment/unusual-activity alerts and virtual cards. It lists the purchase APR (16.99% variable), typical credit limits ($25,000–$150,000), annual fee ($200), foreign transaction fee (0%), minimum payment (2.5%), and late fee ($32.50), plus autopay options and a $750 minimum credit score for applying.
faqs: How do I activate my Platinum Rewards Card and set up digital wallet use?
